paragraphs.source_en: Ōmandokoro was beset by worries: Hideyoshi was nearly sixty, so why was he still so eager for war? Why could he not live quietly in the capital? Might some calamity befall him on the battlefield? How far apart were Japan and Korea? What sort of place was the Great Ming realm?
